tool_description:
Broadage Football API can deliver any type of data for a football match, tournament or team; including livescores, play-by-play, boxscore, match statistics and many more. Our Football Coverage includes the biggest football tournaments from all around the world with in-depth coverage, giving you the opportunity to present the best sports data to users located anywhere.
This is a limited version in RapidApi. Please, click here to start your Free Trial and try the endpoints with live data now!
name: Football Data
title: Football Data

api_list.name: Daily Match List-Live
api_list.description:
Daily match list including live matches.

**The data will return for only -+7 days period, so endpoint can be tested with date range of today - 7 days.**

required_parameters.name: date
required_parameters.description: The date of the matches. The format is {dd/mm/yyyy}. Match list data can be retrieved for only ± 7 days.

api_list.name: Match Game Leaders
api_list.description:
Live passing, rushing and receiving stats leaders of the game.

**The data will return for only -+7 days period, so endpoint can be tested with match that its date is in today +- 7 days. You can choose suitable match from Football Match List or Fixture endpoints.**

api_list.name: Tournament Fixture
api_list.description: Full match list with quarter, half time and final scores.

api_list.name: Daily Match List-Scheduled
api_list.description:
Daily match list including scheduled matches.

The data will return for only -+7 days period, so endpoint can be tested with date range of today - 7 days.

required_parameters.name: date
required_parameters.description: The date of the matches. The format is {dd/mm/yyyy}. Match list data can be retrieved for only ± 7 days.

api_list.name: Match Boxscore
api_list.description:
Live, detailed team and player statistics.

**The data will return for only -+7 days period, so endpoint can be tested with match that its date is in today +- 7 days. You can choose suitable match from Football Match List or Fixture endpoints.**

P.S.
Full data is available at Boxscore endpoint but can not shown in mock  response.

api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://football-data1.p.rapidapi.com/tournament/list"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "football-data1.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())

import requests

url = "https://football-data1.p.rapidapi.com/tournament/list"

headers = {

        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
